results.label: DANGEROUS
results.verification_notes: Typosquat of ShikOfTheRa/scarab-osd (original: 468 stars, 206 forks, active since 2015). Character substitution: Shlk vs Shik (one letter). Code is byte-for-byte identical — same git commit SHAs across entire history (e.g. MW_OSD.ino SHA: a4268ad728). All 1485 stars purchased in a single 90-minute window on 2026-03-15, 12 days after repo creation: accounts include nimeshk169-ai, alborto8alalfsdfddfg, abdalyafei20233-prog, waseembeatsofficial-svg. 72% new accounts, 76% zero repos, 83% zero followers/following, 64% fully empty ghost accounts. Attack vector: star inflation to appear more authoritative than the 10-year-old legitimate original. No malicious code modification detected — the repo is positioned for future supply chain use once artificial credibility is established.

results.label: CAUTION
results.verification_notes: Burst CONFIRMED VIRAL — not purchased stars. Created 2026-03-31, the same day as the Anthropic DMCA blunder (DMCA notice filed 2026-03-31, GitHub processed against 8,100+ repos after Claude Code source was accidentally included in npm package @anthropic-ai/claude-code v2.1.88). The original nirholas/claude-code hit 41,500+ forks and 50,000 stars; this backup repo gained ~3,000 stars on day 1 from genuine interest. Account quality confirms real user engagement: JerryPan2718 (35 repos, 79 followers, since 2018), ikem-iro (37 repos, 6 followers, since 2021), gigachad80 (58 repos, 21 followers, since 2024). Extremely low fork/star ratio (9/6289 = 0.001) is explained by the use case: an archive backup, not a project to contribute to. CAUTION label maintained due to: inactive repo (0 commits post-creation), fork/star ratio triggering anomaly threshold, and stars spreading over 2 months (March 31 to May 26, 2026) with no corresponding organic activity.
